name: family-travel-editor
description: Plan and edit family travel films with a repeatable, human-reviewed DaVinci Resolve workflow.

interface.longDescription: An experimental local workflow for family travel films: reconstruct trip context, plan scenes, draft narration, edit in DaVinci Resolve, check exports and apply timecoded feedback. Requires your footage and a local editor. Optional services are configured separately. Includes a synthetic example; does not promise automatic finished films.
defaultPrompt: Help me plan the first scene from my travel footage.
Apply my timecoded comments to a new version of my family film.
